sources.name: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.coverage: UK fixed broadband availability, full-fibre take-up and mobile coverage snapshot as of January 2026, with downloadable fixed and mobile coverage data
sources.update_cadence: Connected Nations annual report plus interim updates; this snapshot published 13 May 2026
sources.access: Official report, interactive report and downloadable coverage files
sources.licence: Ofcom data terms of use and attribution conditions
sources.role: Current broadband/mobile availability baseline for area and postcode-level connectivity screening
sources.limitations: Mobile coverage is based on operator signal-strength predictions; fixed availability is not a live service-order guarantee and some metrics are aggregated

sources.name: Broadband and mobile coverage checker and API
sources.coverage: Postcode-based fixed broadband availability and mobile coverage by provider across the UK
sources.update_cadence: Refreshed from Ofcom coverage datasets; checker page last updated 25 June 2025
sources.access: Interactive postcode checker plus developer API
sources.role: High-value postcode-level internet-access precheck and provider-coverage evidence
sources.limitations: Checker does not report live maintenance or outages; mobile results are modelled/predicted and postcode evidence is not a property service guarantee

sources.name: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployments 2026
sources.coverage: Operator plans for full-fibre, gigabit-capable and fixed-wireless high-capacity network deployment through the end of 2028
sources.update_cadence: Annual forward-looking report; 2026 edition published 13 May 2026 from January 2026 plans
sources.access: Official report, local/unitary authority data package, XLSX tables and methodology annex
sources.role: Future internet-access growth and planned-network evidence distinct from current coverage
sources.limitations: Plans are operator statements rather than guaranteed builds; public-authority aspirations are not separately included and confidence varies by design/funding status

sources.name: Connected Nations 2025 fixed broadband performance data

sources.licence: Ofcom data terms of use and attribution conditions
sources.role: Observed active-connection speed context to complement availability-only sources
sources.limitations: From 2024 onward Ofcom considers performance robust to area level rather than postcode level; output areas with insufficient lines may be excluded

sources.name: Open Market Review determinations and BDUK plans

sources.limitations: Not comprehensive for historic vouchers, Gigahubs and Superfast delivery; individual releases can be corrected or replaced and must be version-pinned
